item.title: Hoppy Valley Brewers Fest Returns for 3rd Year in New Location
item.description: A craft beverage festival is returning to the State College area for its third year with a new location and an expanded variety of offerings. item.title: New Centre County Nonprofit Aims to Meet Growing Demand for Youth Robotics and STEM Education
item.description: A new nonprofit organization is working to meet the growing demand for youth robotics and other science, technology, engineering and math extracurricular programs in Centre County. item.title: State College YMCA AquaLions Win CenKey Swim League Championship
item.description: The State College Area YMCA AquaLions captured the CenKey Swim League title after the 2026 championship competition on Saturday and Sunday. Hosted by the State College Y, the championships welcomed 501 youth swimmers from 10 teams across central Pennsylvania. The AquaLions, represented by 118 swimmers, emerged victorious with a team score of 2,783 to advance to the Pennsylvania YMCA District Championships on March 6-8 and State Championships on March 20-22. item.description: PETERSBURG — It may still be winter, but the Sugar Shack at Shaver’s Creek Environmental Center is ready to warm up again as the center prepares for the 2026 Maple Harvest Festival. item.title: CentrePeace Dispels Rumors About Organization’s Future Amid Impending Rockview Prison Closure
item.description: With Rockview state prison closing in March, CentrePeace Executive Director Barbara Squires has heard the rumors that the future of her organization and its work is in doubt. She wants community members to know that they aren't true.
